Definition: properly, something disgusting (morally), i.e. (as noun) an abhorrence; especially idolatry or (concretely) an idol
BiblicalUsage: 1) a disgusting thing, abomination, abominable; 1a) in ritual sense (of unclean food, idols, mixed marriages); 1b) in ethical sense (of wickedness etc)
